MCIPAC_rule: NFE; not a federal agency; not a NAFI; private individuals operate/control internally
Kadena_rule: self-sustained group outside federal official capacity; functions separate from official military duties; local OI does not use full not-NAFI wording
allowed_interpretation: Both regimes separate the PO from a government unit; quote each regime's exact formulation

MCIPAC_rule: CG/DC written permission to operate on MCIPAC-MCBB facilities/areas
Kadena_rule: 18 MSG written consent; authorization may be withdrawn
allowed_interpretation: Both create installation-specific operating permission through different command chains

MCIPAC_rule: NFE is established, operated and controlled by individuals outside federal capacity
Kadena_rule: 18 MSG supervision is limited to authorization/withdrawal and does not dictate internal activities or structure
allowed_interpretation: Access authority and internal organization must be represented as separate layers

MCIPAC_rule: MCCS processes requests, maintains cognizance and may audit
Kadena_rule: 18 FSS administers/monitors; FSR maintains electronic files and coordinates approval
allowed_interpretation: MCCS/FSS are administrative interfaces, not parent organizations
missing_scope: actual actor-specific monitoring and audit actions

MCIPAC_rule: annual budget plus quarterly financial statement, minutes, checklist and contact list submitted to MCCS
Kadena_rule: electronic file includes bylaws, revalidation, quarterly bank/income-expense records, receipts, officers, minutes, insurance/audit/tax materials
allowed_interpretation: The rules establish recurring governance/financial reporting beyond IRS filings
missing_scope: retention period, completeness, releaseability and named files

MCIPAC_rule: probation, suspension and revocation for late reports or violations; repeated offenses can permanently revoke installation authorization
Kadena_rule: document failures trigger escalating suspension; the fourth occurrence is stated as 'Dissolution of the PO'; 18 MSG can withdraw authorization
allowed_interpretation: Both tie compliance to installation governance, but Kadena additionally states fourth-occurrence 'Dissolution of the PO'; preserve that textual asymmetry
missing_scope: actual sanctions, procedural records, and the Kadena clause's legal effect outside installation recognition/status

MCIPAC_rule: continuous DoD space use requires real-estate license; occasional use separately authorized
Kadena_rule: event locations require facility-manager approval/building coordination; no general permanent-room/lease clause in the local OI
allowed_interpretation: MCIPAC supports a general continuous-license rule; Kadena supports event approval only in this source
missing_scope: named rooms, leases, rents and permanent-space instruments

MCIPAC_rule: continuous-use utilities/materials/services and other costs are reimbursable; limited logistics is conditional; own equipment is the default
Kadena_rule: 18 FSS equipment/services/support are assessed normal fees and charges
allowed_interpretation: Public rules support cost recovery/normal charges, not an assumption of free support
missing_scope: named fees, payments, waivers and transaction values

MCIPAC_rule: category exceptions include used-goods thrift shops and authorized gift shops
Kadena_rule: KOSC Gift Corner and Kadena Enlisted Spouses Club Thrift Store are expressly authorized
allowed_interpretation: Resale permission is a distinct institutional position that can be modeled separately from money flows
missing_scope: current continuity, room/lease, revenue, exclusivity and X007 identity

MCIPAC_rule: POs are self-sustaining; no NAFI financial assistance; limited lawful support remains possible
Kadena_rule: POs are self-sustained; 18 FSS use is normally charged; the local OI does not enumerate all higher-level support exceptions
allowed_interpretation: Neither local rule supports coding command/MCCS/FSS as a funder of a named PO
missing_scope: actor-specific awards, appropriated-fund support or waived fees
